title: F1597 AMRC-Informed Method C State Transfer and Re-Equilibration Verification
finding: Implemented and validated AMRC-informed Method C state-transfer pipeline between candidate donor (h=2.5 um, 1600 quads) and Candidate C2 receiver (h=1.0 um, 2300 quads): (1) AMRC KDTree active-zone tagging identifies 1822 refinement elements within radius r=2*ell_0=15 um; (2) Inequality bound transfer d*(x) >= d_lb(x) guarantees strictly 0 healing nodes (min Delta d = 0.0); (3) Kuhn-Tucker strain history H >= 0 verified across all 4 Gauss points of all 2300 receiver quads (min H = 4.7221e-06); (4) Bourdin AT2 fracture energy continuity preserved within 0.42% (tolerance <= 2.0%); (5) 2-step mechanical re-equilibration deck structured to resolve Abaqus Section 34.2.1 static displacement limitation.

limitation: The AMRC-informed transfer and re-equilibration pipeline has been verified offline with analytical Mode-I donor fields and discrete crack-band meshes. Authentic continuation on the HPC cluster requires running the qualified candidate donor to completion, transferring solved ODB state, and executing the receiver re-equilibration solve. Method C Gate C1-1 remains FAILED until solver evidence confirms Delta RF <= 5%, Delta E_frac <= 2%, and zero healing.
next_operation: Prepare and submit qualified candidate donor batch manifest (candidate_donor_h0025.inp, 1600 quads, 1 CPU serial) on HPC cluster, extract solved checkpoint state at transfer point, and execute AMRC-informed receiver re-equilibration solve.
